title: Time to rebook nudge
description: Nudge clients to rebook around when their last service is due again. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for salons and spas.
keywords: time for a touch up whatsapp
notes: Trigger it from the service interval (for example 6 weeks after a colour). Timing matters more than discount.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, it's been {{days}} days since your last *{{service}}*. Time for a refresh? {{stylist}} has openings this week at {{studio}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
